title: Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 for Weyl algebras: Lean 4 formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 for Weyl algebras over every characteristic-zero field and every rank, including rank zero. For each nonzero d, the main theorem proves the existence of F, R, and S with the ordered identity 1 = dR + FdS. At positive rank, the fixed-source theorem uses a linear symplectic coordinate to the intrinsic Bernstein degree of d. The formal proof proceeds through symplectic monicization, the canonical right-ideal quotient and Euler identity, filtered support estimates, Poisson involutivity, coisotropic geometry, scalar descent, and certificate extraction. Mathlib-only Challenge modules define the main and fixed-source statements independently of their proofs; separate Solution modules prove them. The repository includes proof maps, Comparator configurations, consumer checks, and verification records. Its paper–Lean map distinguishes statement agreement from proof-route correspondence and records the selected manuscript comparison's scope and open proof obligations. The registered Palomar entry certifies only its named theorem and source revision. Manuscript materials retain their stated CC BY 4.0 license; this software is Apache-2.0.
notes: Kernel-checked Lean proof. Independent human expert review of the mathematics and the accompanying manuscript are separate; see docs/verification.md for the exact scope of the machine check.
